leg.text: Nicol Bolas hatches together with Ugin and watches their sister Merrevia Sal die, and the loss sets his course toward power.
He starts the Dragon-killers' War by tricking dragon hunters into a feud, sowing discord among the heirs, luring two of them up the birth mountain to fight and burning the unguarded temple.
He then poisons the king's second wife with words of greed and vanity until she kills her husband, and when she and the king's son stab each other dead, Bolas takes rule over their people.

In the Elder Dragon War that follows, Bolas's sorcerers kill Ravus, he turns Lividus against Vaevictis to escape, and he sets the dragon clans against each other until the war reaches Jamuraa, where Ugin saves Sabboth and Bolas's spark ignites in rage and envy.

Later he sends Ramses Overdark to reclaim the rebellious Edemi Islands and names him imperial regent, but Tetsuo finally draws Bolas to the Meditation Plane, destroys the shrine with Hage's hammer and kills him.

vis.text: Nicol Bolas lures Rakka Mar with the promise of more magical power, and she uses her influence among Jund's human war clans to promote greater Life Hunts.
Rakka gains dark powers of elementalism from her bond with Bolas, and she saves Sarkhan Vol and presents her master to him.

tsp.text: Nicol Bolas has already shaped Dominaria's history, fighting the first planeswalker battle against a demonic leviathan and reigning for 150 years as God-Emperor after slaying the Empress of Madara.

After Tetsuo Umezawa kills him on the Meditation Plane, Bolas escapes the rift and is reborn using Venser's latent spark, then defeats Teferi in a duel and leaves swearing vengeance once he is convinced of the rifts' dangers.
Leshrac, who accepted the Myojin's bargain to fight him, strips Jeska of her Phage powers and attacks Bolas, rotting his body as they fight from world to world.
But Bolas reveals he had been playing Leshrac all along, impales him, traps his essence in the true mask and frees Jeska, and then uses the trapped essence to close the Madaran rift and kill Leshrac.

fut.text: Nicol Bolas fights Ajani and is driven from Alara during the Conflux.

ala.text: Nicol Bolas works through others on Alara: Tezzeret reaches him and is promised power in exchange for servitude, and Sarkhan swears allegiance to him and exchanges blood.
Bolas sees his memory and power slipping away because of the Mending, so he forms a multi-part plan to restore his glory and gain unmatched power, though little time is left and he may be discovered.
He leaves the Maelstrom unguarded because it destroys or scares off interlopers on its own, and Sarkhan's mind unravels when he sees Bolas absorb it and be defeated by a duplicate avatar.
Ajani's quest for his brother's killer ends in a face-to-face conflict with Bolas, and Ajani summons the essence of Bolas's soul so the two dragons vanish.

con.text: Nicol Bolas prepares the shards for the Conflux by recruiting minions, among them Gwafa Hazid and Rakka Mar, and using Rakka's influence to promote greater Life Hunts so the war clans will be ready for war.

He foments chaos and destroys the obelisks, speeding the merging of the shards, and once the five worlds become one he orders Malfegor to assemble an army of necromancers and undead to destroy the remaining human holdouts on Grixis.
His minions in the Order of the Skyward Eye spread paranoia through Bant as his long machinations near triumph.
Ajani Goldmane stops Bolas from destroying all of Alara, absorbing the last of the Maelstrom and banishing him from the plane.

m12.text: Nicol Bolas has long collected relationships, so Sarkhan Vol became Sarkhan the Mad and Tezzeret the Seeker became Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas.

ktk.text: Nicol Bolas tracks Ugin to Tarkir, gravely injures him, mines his mind for information about the Eldrazi and leaves him to die.
With Ugin dead the elemental storms end, and in the original timeline Yasova is tricked into aiding Bolas, which lets the clans hunt Tarkir's dragons to extinction.
Sarkhan Vol uses Ugin's Nexus to travel 1,280 years back, where he finds that Yasova is a willing pawn of Bolas, who sent her false visions and ordered her to track dragon storms.
At Ugin's grave a disguised Bolas nearly conquers Naiva's mind and offers her the reign of Tarkir, but Yasova saves her and tricks him into fleeing, so Ugin's survival is never revealed to him.

frf.text: Nicol Bolas and Ugin, long-time rivals, finally clash in the sky above Tarkir while Sarkhan arrives to watch.
Bolas had corrupted Yasova Dragonclaw, who admits she helped him in the hope of ending the storms, and Sarkhan realizes the golden dragon in her vision was Bolas, already on Tarkir in the past.
Bolas fights Ugin, Yasova's spell grips Sarkhan, and Ugin is mortally wounded.

dtk.text: Nicol Bolas appears in Ugin's path and the two dragon planeswalkers trade spells, with Bolas barraging Ugin before the Tarkir dragons attack their own progenitor while Bolas watches.
Bolas delivers the deathblow that breaks Ugin's body, then turns toward the sky and vanishes, and Ugin falls on Tarkir, carving the chasm of the Crucible.
Later Ugin tells Sorin that Bolas thought him a rival for power and used his own dragons against him, and Sarkhan and Ugin piece together how Bolas manipulated Sarkhan and changed Tarkir's history.

akh.text: Nicol Bolas corrupts a pre-existing plane, killing every being old enough to walk, overtaking the gods and sealing three away while brainwashing five to steward it.
He engineers a world where inhabitants reach perfection and then fight in the Trials, all to create an army of Eternals, and he sets a promise of his return into the gods and the people.
Nissa and Chandra find that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago, and Samut finds a sealed chamber showing the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser who caused the calamity.

The Gatewatch arrives to take him on, but Bolas defeats them, crushing Jace's mind and wounding Gideon until he planeswalks away, while Bolas's return in the Hour of Devastation kills most of the gods.

hou.text: Nicol Bolas returns as the God-Pharaoh when the Second Sun reaches its final position, and the promised afterlife proves to be a factory that turns the worthy into an army of Eternals.
He taunts each member of the Gatewatch, declares his work complete and the plane's usefulness over, and defeats them, so that Gideon, Chandra, Nissa and Liliana flee.
He has Bontu bring Hazoret to him and then kills Bontu, leaving Hazoret the only living god, and his Eternal army destroys Naktamun while the survivors under Hazoret flee.
Bolas also sends Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge, but Karn, Samut, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden defeat him.

rix.text: Nicol Bolas learns of Azor's plot when he interrogates an elf bureaucrat and absorbs a lawmage's mind, then follows Azor's clues to Tarkir where he overpowers Ugin with a swarm of dragon eyes and believes he has won.
He summons Vraska to the Meditation Plane, scours her memories of Ixalan, accepts her false story of a sphinx rampaging through Orazca, and rewards her with a kingdom and the title of guildleader.

Jace and Vraska deduce that Bolas made a transportable army of Eternals aimed at Ravnica and plan to accept his offer and betray him, with Tezzeret spiriting the Immortal Sun away revealing his plan to invade.

bbd.text: Nicol Bolas and Ugin hatch as twin dragons and crash through the canopy, where Nicol is pinned by a tree trunk and wants to help his sister Merrevia Sal while Ugin holds him back.
Freed too late, Nicol wants revenge, and from the peak he sees the bodies of weak dragons and decides that being the hunter is better.
The twins spend years perfecting tandem hunting and settle in the colony of Arcades Sabboth, where Nicol takes the name Nicol Bolas.
After watching a sudden quarrel end in a stabbing with satisfaction, Nicol tells Ugin he has found a better way to avenge their sister and flies off without farewells.

m19.text: Nicol Bolas and Ugin find humans who have turned their dead sister into an ornament, and Nicol vows to avenge her with a cunning plan that needs no killing.
Bolas whispers into the mind of a chief's son, persuading him to march against the other heirs, and he lures them into battle, burns the temple and sees the old chief killed by his second wife.
When the son and the second wife kill each other, Bolas proclaims himself the humans' true leader, and Ugin realizes his twin never truly cared for him.
Later he sets Lividus against Vaevictis, ignites clan wars among the dragons and tells Naiva a boastful version of his past, in which he killed Ugin in self-defense.
Vivien remembers that Nicol Bolas destroyed her world, Skalla.

grn.text: Nicol Bolas tries to slowly influence and warp Ravnica while the guilds fight internally over whether to be pulled toward him or away.
He rewards Vraska with the location of Jarad, but she returns to Ravnica, unites the Golgari and pledges the guild against him, while Lazav pledges the Dimir to the same alliance.
Tezzeret traps Lavinia with a device that makes her an unwilling accomplice of Bolas, and Dovin Baan sabotages the Guildpact device just before Bolas arrives.
Bolas slays Niv-Mizzet, leaving only his skull and charred bones, as Vivien remembers Skalla and plans to learn the secret of destroying Bolas.

war.text: Nicol Bolas brings the Immortal Sun to Ravnica and traps planeswalkers there, and the Elderspell harvests their sparks, including Domri's, to fuel his ascension to godhood.
Hundreds of planeswalkers die and their sparks make Bolas nearly invulnerable, and when Gideon strikes with the Blackblade it breaks because Bolas had enchanted it never to hurt another elder dragon.
He stops Jace's team from assassinating Liliana by destroying the buildings under them, but Liliana betrays him, seizes his Dreadhorde and whispers to Oketra and Bontu to turn on him.

Gideon sacrifices himself so the cost of betraying Bolas does not fall on Liliana, and Bontu bites Bolas, reversing the Elderspell, while Niv-Mizzet impales him, and Bolas is imprisoned to contemplate defeat for eternity.

m20.text: Vivien, held in magical stasis in a gilded prison, relives the loss of Skalla and her defeat by Nicol Bolas, then planeswalks away to seek the dragons of Shiv.

cmr.text: Nicol Bolas remade a place in his image, giving him the advantage there, so those who approach it must be careful.

clu.text: Planeswalkers conjure replicas of old allies as reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Nicol Bolas prevailed.

tdm.text: Nicol Bolas, nameless and chained, has lost his memories, and Ugin explains that he made the Meditation Realm a prison for his brother, to be kept until Bolas dies millennia from now.
Elspeth's argument gives Bolas his name and he begins to remember, and as the conflict tips the balance, he recovers his name and escapes.
Bolas laughs as his fetters come undone, and Ugin admits he has failed to keep his brother and that Bolas is free.
